note: Set A is better because it binds key parameters to specific mission names (e.g., LUVOIR-A, LUVOIR-B) more consistently than Set B, which often uses generic descriptions (e.g., 'on-axis telescope'). Set B contains a factual error claiming the Lynx mirror assembly has a 10 m diameter (Claim 20), whereas the text specifies 10 m focal length; Set A correctly identifies focal length in one claim and uses vague terms ('dimension', 'size') in others, which is preferable to false information. Both sets suffer from duplicates and some vague entity extraction, but A's entity binding is more useful for engineering claims.
